scope: Original short synthetic manuscripts; unmodified class files. Templates are research/test dependencies; no TeX engine bundled.

aastex.version_boundary: Publisher currently advertises 7.0.2; this installed-version test covers 7.0.1 only.

acmart_installed.distribution_condition: Generated cls must be distributed with original dtx source. Runtime tests use the installed package.

acmart_current.reproduction: Fetch only when the archive SHA256 matches; generate unchanged acmart.ins with local runTex; use fixture-local cls with paired dtx and original BST. Set PAPER_TEMPLATE_ACM_CURRENT_DIR; no global install or default-test download.
